companyFieldUpdates.description: WideOpenWest, Inc. (WOW!) is a U.S. broadband network operator providing high-speed internet, video, voice, mobile, business data and related connectivity services to residential, commercial and wholesale customers. The company operates across 19 markets in Michigan, Alabama, Tennessee, South Carolina, Georgia and Florida and reports nearly two million network passings. Operations began in 2001; the current corporation was formed in 2012 and adopted the WideOpenWest name in 2017. Crestview first invested in December 2015. DigitalBridge and Crestview completed a $1.5 billion take-private on December 31, 2025 through Bandit Parent and its subsidiaries; DigitalBridge Partners III holds approximately 63% and Crestview III approximately 37% of Bandit Parent's limited-partner interests, with equal general-partner control. InfraBridge is not a direct owner. SoftBank's signed acquisition of DigitalBridge remains an upstream manager transaction and was not treated as a direct WOW ownership transfer through August 19, 2026.
